title: feat(spec): a report nav item without reportName opens the app's report index; the console stops injecting All reports
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhEW5k2a4Vd5KSupfu
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBARQoNehDR2CAhzzKsfZvvA)_

Fixes #27525

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none edited. Four governed hits teach a `report` nav item and all stay true for a named report; none teaches the index form, and none teaches that `reportName` is required: `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:171` (the `report` row lists `reportName`, `label`, `icon`, "Link to a report"), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md:38` (a named example), `skills/objectui/guides/app-composition.md:21` (`{type:'report', reportName}` routes to `/report/:name`) and `:34` (emit the typed target field for the chosen type). Named, not edited.

ADR-0087: a widening, not a retirement. Nothing an author wrote before parses differently.

**The claim's `Metadata-protocol: none` is measured as `added`.** The order says "as measured", and AGENTS.md's kinds put "a new accepted value" under `added`: `{ type: 'report' }` with no `reportName` was refused and is now accepted. The changesets carry `added`, and `@objectstack/spec` is graded `minor`.

**Migration** (in the `@object-ui/app-shell` changeset): an app that relied on the injected row adds one entry to its navigation where the index belongs: `{ id: 'nav_reports', type: 'report' }`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：导航项 `type: 'report'` 不写 `reportName` 时表示「本应用的报表索引」(`/apps/APP/reports`)；控制台不再给每个应用自动加「全部报表」行，只有导航里声明了这一项才画出来；Studio 导航检查器把未选报表的报表项显示为「报表索引」，保存时保留它。
- 为什么改：维护者定了「加上才有」：索引入口由作者自己加。原来每个非 Studio 应用都被注入一行，没有报表的应用也有；而 spec 又不允许作者自己声明一个索引项。
- 风险与回滚：放宽接受集，原来能解析的导航照旧；依赖注入行的应用会少一个入口，迁移是加一行 `{ type: 'report' }`，仓内自带报表的 showcase 与 todo 示例已加。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`（删掉的注入块）、`ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`（`resolveHref` 的 `report` 分支与无标签时的 `reportIndex` 询问）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx`（`NAV_TARGET_OPTIONAL`，保存不再丢掉索引项）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx`，应见 6 个用例全绿：未声明时无「All reports」行，声明后链接到 `/apps/crm/reports` 且在该路由高亮。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Measured on `origin/main` `57c51aab` (before).**

1. Spec: `NavigationItemSchema.safeParse({ id: 'nav_reports', type: 'report' })`:

   ```
   bare report item: [{"expected":"string","code":"invalid_type","path":["reportName"],"message":"Invalid input: expected string, received undefined"}]
   named report item: ACCEPTED
   empty-string reportName: ACCEPTED
   ```

2. Console: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` drew a static row under `{!isStudioApp && (…)}` after the app's `NavigationRenderer`: a `Link` to `${basePath}/reports` with `data-testid="sidebar-report-index"`, text `sidebar.allReports` ("All reports" / 「全部报表」), for every non-Studio app, whatever its navigation or its reports. Pinned on main by `UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexLink-13020.test.tsx` ("links the app's report index, though the navigation names no report").

3. ⌘K: **the card's premise does not hold on main.** `CommandPalette.tsx` already lists reports beyond the navigation: `useAppReportEntries(activeApp, open && !inStudio, gates)` (`views/appReportIndex.ts`, objectui#13020 / #13273 / objectstack#26892), the reports the app ships (its package's own, plus those its served navigation names), limited by `mayOpenReport` to the ones whose datasets read objects the member may read, and by the navigation's gates. That is the same list `AppReportIndexView` shows. Pinned on main by `AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx` ("⌘K offers the app's reports beyond its navigation": a report no entry names is offered to a reader; one on an unreadable object, a joined report with such a block, and another package's report are not). The HotCRM comment the card quotes predates it. So Target 3 needed no new reader; this PR reuses that one and pins it under an index-only navigation (below).

**After (head `dd0bd483`).** The same probe answers `bare report item: ACCEPTED`; the other two lines are unchanged.

### The spec (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`)

`ReportNavItemSchema.reportName` is `z.string().optional()`. Its describe: "Target report name. Omit it and the entry opens the app's report index (the reports the app ships that the member may open) instead of one report." The variant's TSDoc states the two targets and that the console draws an index entry only where the navigation declares one. The unknown-key teaching at `navItemSurface` (`reportname` → "type: 'report' (with reportName)" on every other variant) stays true and is pinned. `stack.zod.ts`'s cross-check of a named `reportName` against `reports` reads `typeof nav.reportName === 'string'`, so an absent name skips it; lint `validate-nav-target-refs` likewise skips an absent target. Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx` (four `reportName` rows go from ✅ to optional with the new text). `check:generated` reports the other 13 artifacts current, `check:authorable-surface` included: the base lists keys (`ui/ReportNavItem:reportName` stays), not required-ness, so it does not move. No metadata-form row or form translation names `reportName`, so no bundle moves.

### Readers of a nav item's `reportName`, measured

| Reader | Absent `reportName`, before | Change |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `layout` `resolveHref` (sidebar link, mobile tab bar, ⌘K, Studio preview, active-row election) | `#`, a dead entry | `BASE/reports`; the active-row election reads the same answer, so the entry lights on the index route (exact match) and not on `report/NAME` |
| `layout` `inheritedNavItemLabel` (label-less entry) | the entry's `id` | asks the host's resolver for the new `{ kind: 'reportIndex' }` target, else the `id` |
| `app-shell` `useNavTargetLabel` (the console's resolver) | n/a | answers `sidebar.allReports` ("All reports" / 「全部报表」), the injected row's own text |
| `app-shell` `UnifiedSidebar` | injected an index row for every non-Studio app | injects nothing; the declared entry is drawn by `NavigationRenderer` |
| `app-shell` `CommandPalette` | n/a (an absent name would put `undefined` in the set of nav-named reports and in the item value) | the index entry is offered as itself; only a non-empty `reportName` counts as nav-named; the value never holds `undefined` |
| `app-shell` `appReportIndex` (`reportNamesIn`) | already skipped a non-string name | unchanged |
| `app-shell` `AppHeader` (breadcrumb) | reads the route, not the nav item | unchanged |
| Studio nav-item inspector (`StudioDesignSurface`) | "unbound", with the "left out of the saved navigation" hint | not unbound; the report picker's empty face reads 「报表索引」 / "Report index", with a hint saying what it opens; picking it removes `reportName` |
| Studio save (`AppNavCanvas` `navPayloadOf`) | left the entry out of the save | kept (`NAV_TARGET_OPTIONAL`); the file's own parity pin (left out exactly when the spec refuses it bare) now judges `report` taken bare |
| metadata-admin `AppNavInspector` | the combo field, empty | adds the 「报表索引」 hint while `reportName` is empty; its live preview shows `/apps/APP/reports` |
| metadata-admin `AppPreview` | dropped a label-less, childless entry with no target | keeps it: the target reads `reports` |
| `navSurface` `bindTarget` (what the Studio rail opens) | `null` | unchanged: the index is no metadata item to design |

### Shipped apps

Every non-Studio app showed the injected row. Read as the maintainer's 「加上才有」: the apps this repo ships that **ship reports** get the entry, so none loses a working index; an app with no report had an index that said "No reports", and gets nothing.

- `examples/app-showcase` (four reports, all named in its navigation): `{ id: 'nav_report_index', type: 'report', icon: 'bar-chart-3' }`, appended last in its reports group so no existing index path moves (`nav-and-detail-grants.test.ts` pins `navigation[3].children[11]`).
- `examples/app-todo` (ships `task.report.ts`, which its navigation never named, so the injected row was its only door): `{ id: 'nav_reports', type: 'report', icon: 'bar-chart-3' }` in its Analytics group.
- `examples/app-crm`, `examples/app-multi-package`: ship no report, unchanged. No package under `packages/` ships a report.

Both new entries carry no `label`, so they show the console's own name for the index and need no translation key.

## Tests

- **Spec pin** (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.test.ts`, replacing "should reject report nav item without reportName"): a bare `report` item parses on the variant, through `NavigationItemSchema` and inside an `AppSchema`, and holds no `reportName` after parse; an unknown key on it is still refused, and `reportName` on a `page` item still answers "type: 'report' (with reportName)"; the describe names the report index.
- **Console** (`UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexEntry-27525.test.tsx`, the 13020 sidebar file moved and rewritten, since its first assertion is now the opposite behaviour): (a) no injected row on an app whose navigation declares no index entry (no "All reports" link, no `/apps/crm/reports` href, no `sidebar-report-index`); (b) a declared label-less index entry links `/apps/crm/reports` named "All reports", a labelled one shows its label; (c) it is the active row on `/apps/crm/reports` and the named report entry is not; (d) drawing it reads no report list; CONTROL: a named report entry still routes to `/apps/crm/report/crm_pipeline`.
- **⌘K** (`AppReportIndex-13020.test.tsx`, new block): under a navigation that declares only `{ type: 'report' }` and names no report, the palette finds "Win Rate" and "Pipeline", and not "Case Aging" (unreadable object), "Mixed Blocks" (a block on it) or "Headcount" (another package); it offers the index entry itself, and its value holds no `undefined`.
- **Studio**: `StudioDesignSurface.navItemTypes-11790` (a report entry is born as the index, parses, is sent, shows the index hint and no "left out" hint, the picker offers `Report index` first; a pick writes `reportName`; the index face removes it again), `StudioDesignSurface.sharedSelect-11865` (`reportBorn` and a new `reportBound` row on the index face), `AppNavCanvas.navPayload-11776` (bare `report` taken and sent).
- Updated for the removed row: `UnifiedSidebar.iconModeLabelFocus-12795` (the tab walk no longer ends on "All reports") and `UnifiedSidebar.favoritesMenu-12427` (no row to exclude).

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

All on the shared container, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- Spec, at `0b6a152e` (pre-merge): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` → `Test Files  751 passed (751)`, `Tests  22330 passed | 1 todo`; `test:repo` → `Test Files  86 passed (86)`, `Tests  1432 passed`; `typecheck` → `VERDICT command-exit 0` (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- Spec, after merging `origin/main` (head `dd0bd483`): `build` + `check:generated` → "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date"; `test` → `Test Files  752 passed (752)`, `Tests  22341 passed | 1 todo`.
- ui, 138 files that import or pin the edited modules (the sidebar, ⌘K, report index, Studio nav inspector and save, metadata-admin nav inspector / canvas / preview, `@object-ui/layout`, the `@object-ui/types` nav and mirror-parity suites), `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 FILES`: first run 4 red, all four pinning the old behaviour (a bare report entry unbound / left out of the save / not taken bare); updated as listed above. Final, on `dd0bd483`: `Test Files  138 passed (138)`, `Tests  1755 passed (1755)`. Narrowed to these files on purpose; CI's Test UI runs the rest.
- ui type-check, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: all four `type-check: Done`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The full `turbo run build --concurrency=2` (115/115 tasks, the console's `tsc` included) is green too.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

One ablation, of the behaviour the console pins test: `resolveHref`'s index answer put back to `'#'` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`, anchor hit 1 → 0, blob `9f866973` → `f4b35fdd`), then the sidebar and report-index files run (the ui suites alias `@object-ui/layout` to its source, so no build sits between): `Tests  3 failed | 13 passed`: (b) both "draws a declared index entry" cases and (c) "the active row" went red. Restored: blob `9f866973` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The ⌘K index-entry pin stayed green under it, as expected: it asserts the entry is offered, not where it goes. (a) "no injected row" is the inverse of the assertion `main` pinned (`UnifiedSidebar.reportIndexLink-13020.test.tsx`: "links the app's report index, though the navigation names no report"), so it is red against `main`'s sidebar by construction.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `reportName: ''` was accepted by the spec before and still is (this PR widens absence only). The console read `''` as falsy and answered `#`; it now answers the index, the same as absence.
- The mobile tab bar (`AppSchemaRenderer`) takes no label resolver, so a label-less index entry there shows its `id`, as every other label-less entry already does in that host.
- Teaching text outside this PR's claimed file surface does not mention the index form: `packages/cli/src/commands/explain.ts:226` (`os explain app` says every item needs its type's target key, "report -> `reportName`") and `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx` / `content/docs/ui/reports.mdx` (the Report Navigation sections). Neither now teaches a refused shape. A ready patch for both is with the seat; carrier: seat 3.
- The Studio's "+" still sends a new report entry into the create-a-report flow; an index entry is made by choosing the `report` type on an entry and leaving the report unpicked.
